title: Choose UpClose's visual world
question: The roll assigned Prep Bay. Keep it, take the pick or the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Prep Bay
options.lineage: body-shop paint prep: primer, masking paper, tape and marker
options.thesis: Mask off everything that isn't the car, then mark what's on it: the page performs UpClose's two-step SAM mechanism in body-shop masking materials.
options.viewport: A full-width car at real scale with masking paper taped across the top and bottom bands; the headline is stencilled on the top sheet, findings are circled in red oxide on the car, and the blue-tape action plus the 8-zone strip sit on the bottom sheet.
options.risk: Body-shop cues can read as a repair service, so the copy must keep it about buying.

raised.raise: Total palette commitment: every surface is primer grey, and colour only means masked, exposed, or flagged.
Zone-board discipline: the 8 zones are fixed rows whose state restyles in place, without the grid moving.
The car stays whole at every size and the panels restack around it.
One reserved action colour (painter's-tape blue), never used as decoration.
Processing is shown as named phases with text equivalents: car found, masked, checked, scored.

options.label: Check-out Sheet
options.lineage: the rental-counter vehicle damage sheet in carbonless triplicate
options.thesis: The report is the walkaround damage sheet everyone has signed at a rental counter, except nothing left unmarked is assumed clean.
options.viewport: A full-viewport canary carbon form: the title bar holds the headline, a four-view car diagram takes the centre with ballpoint circles and hatched NOT SEEN zones, and the action is a stamp box.
options.risk: The most familiar 'honest report' direction; it can turn skeuomorphic and quaint if the form grid goes soft.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse
options.thesis: Zones as departure rows flipping from FILMED to CHECKED.
options.viewport: A board of 8 zone rows with live status flaps.
options.case: Fuses well for progress, but buyers at a car don't identify with a station, and it hides the mechanism.
options.risk: Black ground and travel cues pull away from cars.
options.kept: Zone-board discipline: fixed rows whose state restyles in place.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.thesis: One amber light that flattens every colour.
options.viewport: An amber hall with a mirrored sun.
options.case: No buyer identification and no product clarity.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.viewport: Horizon bands stacked dark to light.
options.case: Elegant for progress, but foreign to buyers and to cars.
options.risk: Dark ground near the banned black theme.

options.label: Minihompy Room
options.thesis: Your inspection as a room you furnish.
options.case: Playful identity with no fit for a buying decision.
options.kept: The object stays whole at every size.

options.label: Punk Paste-up
options.case: Loud, but it erodes the trust that evidence needs.

options.label: Elbow Panel Console
options.thesis: Pastel pill controls on black glass.
options.case: Black-and-lilac ground conflicts with the brief, and it has no car tie.
options.kept: The frame itself is the layout grid.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean car-marketplace page executed well: white ground, one blue action, big car photography, a trust row.
canonCard.viewport: A headline and CTA over a large car photo, with a 3-step row below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every listing site by design.
